notes: Sound that stays. A review of the recorder turned up three ways a recording could end up silent without saying so, and all three are fixed: the nodes that carry the sound are now held in script (an unreferenced one has been collected mid-recording in Chrome before), a page whose audio starts asleep is woken - and says so in the panel if it will not wake - and stopping the share during the three-second countdown now cancels the recording instead of starting it on a dead track. Cancel also reaches a small upload now, where it used to do nothing, and two lines that still claimed a file was in Downloads have been corrected.
